T: One day off. Make it delicious.
D: A high schooler fakes sick for a day of adventure in Chicago with his best mate and girlfriend.
P: Serve the mains when Ferris gets a table at Chez Quis as the Sausage King of Chicago.
S: the ball game, where Ferris catches a foul ball

All-beef franks in steamed poppy seed buns dragged through the garden: mustard, bright relish, onion, tomato, pickle spear, sport peppers and celery salt. Simmer 8 all-beef franks for 5 minutes. Brush 8 hot dog buns with water, sprinkle with poppy seeds and steam 2 minutes until soft. Put a frank in each bun and top in this order: yellow mustard, sweet relish, chopped white onion, 2 tomato wedges, a dill pickle spear, 2 pickled peppers and a pinch of celery salt.
Small choux puffs filled with chive whipped goat's cheese
Tiny gougères (choux with gruyère) piped and baked at 200C for 20 minutes, split and filled with a spoon of whipped goat's cheese and chives.
Mini deep dish pizzas baked in a muffin tin with sausage, mozzarella and tomato
Buttery cornmeal dough pressed into a mini muffin tin, mozzarella, Italian sausage and chunky tomato, baked at 210C for 18 minutes.
M: Grilled Italian sausages with soft peppers and onions in crusty rolls, hot mustard
Italian sausages grilled slowly, capsicum and onion softened in the fat with oregano, piled into crusty rolls with hot mustard.
sauce on top, the Chicago way

Buttery cornmeal crust pressed up a deep tin, layered with mozzarella and a slab of fennel sausage, with chunky tomato, oregano and parmesan on top. Mix 350g plain flour, 50g cornmeal, 7g yeast, 1 tsp salt, 60g melted butter and 230ml warm water, knead and prove 1 hour. Press into a greased 25cm deep tin, up the sides. Layer 250g sliced mozzarella, then 400g Italian sausage meat pressed flat. Simmer 400g crushed tomatoes with garlic and oregano for 10 minutes and spread on top. Scatter 40g parmesan and bake at 220C for 35 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.
W: Cream filled choux puffs with warm dark chocolate sauce
Choux pastry piped into small puffs, baked at 200C until hollow, filled with vanilla cream and topped with warm chocolate sauce.
K: Fresh lemon juice and sparkling mineral water served in wine glasses, no alcohol
Fresh lemon and sugar topped with sparkling mineral water, served in wine glasses like a fancy lunch.

dishes.make_ahead: Puffs up to 1 day airtight, fill just before serving

steps.text: Boil the water and butter, beat in the flour and cook a minute. Cool.
Beat in the eggs and Gruyere.
Pipe small rounds and bake at 200C.

dishes.make_ahead: Press the dough into the tin and fill the cases up to 4 hours ahead, covered in the fridge; bake just before serving

steps.text: Knead the cornmeal into the dough and press into a 12-hole mini muffin tin.
Squeeze the sausage meat out of its casings and crumble.
Fill the cases with mozzarella, sausage and crushed tomato.
Bake at 210C until bubbling.

veg.make_ahead: Chop the sausages and dice the mozzarella up to 1 day ahead; press, fill and bake on the night

steps.text: Knead the cornmeal into the dough and press into a 12-hole mini muffin tin.
Chop the vegetarian sausages into small pieces.
Fill the cases with mozzarella, sausage pieces and crushed tomato.
Bake at 210C until bubbling.

dishes.make_ahead: Slice the capsicums and onions up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; grill the sausages and soften the vegetables just before serving

steps.text: Grill the sausages slowly until browned all over.
Slice the capsicums and onions.
In the same pan, soften the capsicums and onions in the fat with the oregano.
Pile the sausages and peppers into the rolls and add hot mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the capsicums and onions up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cook the sausages and vegetables on the night

steps.text: Grill the vegetarian sausages slowly in half the oil until browned all over.
Slice the capsicums and onions.
In the same pan, soften the capsicums and onions in the rest of the oil with the oregano.
Pile the sausages and peppers into the rolls and add hot mustard.

dishes.make_ahead: Puffs up to 1 day airtight, fill and sauce to serve

steps.text: Boil the water and butter, beat in the flour until it leaves the pan, then cool.
Beat in the eggs and pipe 16 small puffs.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden, then cool.
Whip most of the cream with the vanilla, split the puffs and fill.
Melt the chocolate with the remaining cream and pour over.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the lemon base up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Squeeze the lemons, keeping a few thin slices, and stir with the sugar until dissolved.
Pour into a jug with the sparkling water and plenty of ice.
Serve in wine glasses with a lemon slice.

Deep dish bites.veg: Mini deep dish pizzas baked in a muffin tin with veggie sausage, mozzarella and tomato

Sausage King of Chicago.veg: Grilled Italian style veggie sausages with soft peppers and onions in crusty rolls, hot mustard

s.note: Small choux puffs filled with chive whipped goat's cheese
s.how: Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour and cook a minute. Cool, beat in 2 eggs and 60g gruyère. Pipe small rounds and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Split and fill with 120g goat's cheese whipped with chives.

s.note: Mini deep dish pizzas baked in a muffin tin with sausage, mozzarella and tomato
s.how: Knead 300g pizza dough with 2 tbsp cornmeal and press into a 12-hole mini muffin tin. Fill with diced mozzarella, crumbled sausage from 2 Italian sausages and chunky crushed tomato. Bake at 210C for 18 minutes until bubbling.

m.note: Grilled Italian sausages with soft peppers and onions in crusty rolls, hot mustard
m.how: Grill 8 Italian sausages slowly until browned. In the same pan, soften 2 sliced capsicums and 2 sliced onions in the fat with 1 tsp oregano. Pile the sausages and peppers into 4 long crusty rolls and add hot mustard.

w.note: Cream filled choux puffs with warm dark chocolate sauce
w.how: Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour until it leaves the pan, cool 5 minutes and beat in 2 eggs. Pipe 16 small puffs and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Split, fill with 300ml cream whipped with 1 tsp vanilla, and pour over 100g dark chocolate melted with 80ml cream.

d.note: Fresh lemon juice and sparkling mineral water served in wine glasses, no alcohol
d.how: Stir 125ml fresh lemon juice with 100g caster sugar until dissolved. Pour into a jug with 1L chilled sparkling mineral water and plenty of ice. Serve in wine glasses with a thin lemon slice, fancy restaurant style.
